dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, RunAPI media generation and task status checks, matches the instructions to list models, validate model parameters, create media tasks, and report task IDs, statuses, output URLs, and costs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad, especially generic media requests and "check this task," but the runtime workflow is limited to RunAPI media tasks and includes safeguards such as model validation, no invented model slugs, no hardcoded prices, and confirmation before video, music, or batch task creation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a single non-executable SKILL.md file; no install scripts, package hooks, shell commands, or bundled code are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on RunAPI MCP tools and can submit external generation tasks that may have costs or temporary output URLs, which is proportionate for a media-generation integration when user-directed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, local credential access, local file indexing, privilege escalation, or destructive actions are instructed; storage is discussed only as user-owned durable handling for generated files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad media-generation triggers are mostly consistent with the skill's purpose, though "check this task" should be treated as RunAPI task-status context only; this does not show hidden behavior or unsafe automatic execution.
[static-scan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, which is consistent with the simple markdown-only artifact.
[virustotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean, and there were no non-VT malicious signals supplied.
llm.guidance: Install this if you want your agent to use RunAPI for generated images, video, music, audio, speech, and task polling. Be aware that requests may be sent to RunAPI, generated output URLs may be temporary, and some task creation can incur provider costs; confirm ambiguous or expensive media requests before proceeding.
llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward RunAPI media-generation helper with disclosed external task submission and no hidden install or persistence behavior.
